topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I just found my college application essay on a blog. How could this be? I poured my heart into those words, thinking they were just for the admissions committee. Now, they're out there for anyone to see. I can't stop thinking about how many people might have read it. What if someone from my school sees it? What if it gets back to my teachers, or worse, my parents? I need to figure out how to get it taken down, but I don’t even know where to start. I have to fix this, and I need to do it now.
